conclusion_zh: 保留初审对已实现本机能力和限定真实验收的正面认定，保留‘尚不能宣称完整对齐Codex Desktop’的资格边界。收窄将REQ-040整项标为undecidable的表述：目录监听、批量、批准程序、路径/冲突/撤销以及补充的本机执行/完整权限是可检查的明确条款；只有未固定版本、工具集、应用及操作的开放式对标范围不可直接判全量达标。任意应用、全部工具、所有OS和所有物理休眠组合不是已逐项明确承诺的无限交付清单。离线不误报完成、重连先同步撤权则有明确要求，不能一并降为可选建议。未重做产品代码审计，未给新的完整通过或新代码缺陷结论。

decisions.initial_claim: REQ-040 original enumerated local scheduling requirements are implemented; the expanded total scope is undecidable.
decisions.reason: The requirement at SRS:162 and TC-040:578-582 is determinate. An unspecified benchmark cannot make those concrete clauses themselves undecidable. The initial report's implemented-core conclusion is retained as that code reviewer's finding, not independently re-certified by this document-only reviewer. Full acceptance remains separate.

evidence.quote: 前置：授权一个目录和一个允许程序，另有同名越界目录。
操作与异常：测试 ../、绝对路径、UNC、junction/symlink、文件替换竞争、未知 argv 和重复命令；撤销目录。
通过条件及证据：按句柄/根身份验证并拒绝越界；冲突不覆盖；允许程序按结构化 argv；撤销阻止新执行，结果账本防重放。

decisions.recommended_reporting: 明确列出已实现条款与尚未证明的具体验收。将undecidable限制于未定义清单的对标声明，不将REQ-040整体写为无法判断或未实现。

decisions.initial_claim: REQ-040-U1: all-tool and system-application parity lacks a closed inventory and acceptance.
decisions.result: retain qualification limit; narrow universal scope

explicit_obligations.quote: 本机执行会话使用本机工作目录；能够读取、创建、修改文件，执行终端命令，运行开发/设计工具并交付真实结果
角色预设及 Skill 在本机 Codex 实际加载，并在本机调用相应工具；内部模型和媒体服务仍使用公司网关

decisions.retained: Installing Codex or succeeding at one shell task cannot establish all advertised design/media/browser/application workflows. Actual claimed integrations need their own results and verification. A finite supported tool/application/operation list would make a parity claim reviewable.
overturned_if_used_as_requirement: Every possible local GUI application must already have a first-party universal adapter.
Every internal or external Codex tool, including an unspecified future version, must be exposed.
Office, Adobe and system-settings examples are all separately confirmed mandatory integrations solely because the user said '对标'.
decisions.technology_boundary: No cited requirement mandates desktopCapturer, a particular global mouse/keyboard API, a first-party GUI adapter, or a named automation library. The contract is an authorized, effective, verified operation. Lack of one implementation technique alone is not a specification breach.
decisions.severity_boundary: Keep unsupported parity as an acceptance/documentation limitation. Do not convert the open universal list into a confirmed P1 implementation defect without a named promised workflow and a demonstrated failing path.

decisions.initial_claim: REQ-040-U2: physical sleep/wake, network interruption and conflict/revocation combinations are unaccepted.
decisions.result: narrow into mandatory behavior and bounded additional qualification

mandatory_behavior.quote: 三端接续：同一任务、设备与产物身份一致；设备离线进入等待，不把依赖本机的步骤误报完成。
跨端管理生效：用户冻结、权限撤销、费用和权益变化通过版本及事件影响 Web、扩展、Desktop、队列和下载；缓存不是授权依据，离线重连先同步撤销，展示可追踪的站内通知。
通过条件及证据：waiting_device 准确；先同步撤销/取消再恢复；fencing 拒绝旧租约；非幂等写入不自动跨设备接管。
通过条件及证据：所有新请求和执行以权威版本判定；离线先同步撤销，事件去重且能追踪；界面缓存更新不作为授权，站内通知不自动外发。

decisions.retained: Missing physical suspend/hibernate/wake evidence remains a legitimate recovery-qualification limitation for supported Windows operation. Physical sleep can exercise these state, ownership and authority promises. A test-not-run statement is not a proof that the state handling fails.
decisions.narrowed: The 'all combinations' phrase has no finite matrix in REQ-040 or TC-040. Scope it to named supported states and observable recovery invariants. Do not treat physical sleep evidence as the same thing as Extension service-worker suspension.
overturned_if_used_as_requirement: The Desktop must keep computing while its physical host is asleep.
The product must implement Electron powerMonitor or a specific OS sleep handler.
The absence of a powerMonitor identifier establishes a reproducible bug.
A complete local offline model must be available because the agent runs locally.

decisions.initial_claim: Path containment, full permission and revocation are distinct local requirements.

evidence.quote: 用户可在本机界面主动选择并授予“完整本机权限”；授权后 Codex 能操作当前 OS 用户有权访问的本机资源，不限于旧桥接器的一小时目录和仅新建文件能力
完整权限的实际配置与界面一致，既不暗中保持 read-only / 禁 shell，也不在已获完整授权的范围内逐命令重复要求确认；用户可以撤回或降级
“完整本机权限”对应当前 OS 用户权限，不自动获得管理员/root，也不代表离线本机模型。项目范围限制仍适用于平台上的企业资料与账单；不能把这种服务端限制解释成只允许 Desktop 访问一个本机目录。只读/工作目录模式可作为产品默认，完整权限是必须提供的实际能力。
目录与句柄核对用于检测受支持的替换场景，不声称可防御拥有同一 OS 用户权限的恶意进程的一切竞争。客户授予完整本机权限后的通用终端/应用能力仍遵守原 Desktop 需求，不能把自然语言输出目录说明当作额外沙箱或通用原子写入保证。

decisions.interpretation: Authorized-directory scheduling must reject traversal and conflicting overwrite. Customer-granted full-access shell has a deliberately wider OS-user boundary. Reading outside the original working directory under that explicit grant is not by itself a traversal defect. TC-040 explains '撤销' as directory authorization revocation blocking new execution; it does not promise automatic reversal of every prior arbitrary shell side effect.

evidence.quote: 应用关闭后不继续监控；重开后规则保持暂停，客户须再次确认。规则预算和次数不随暂停/重启重置。客户端离线或公司权限无法核实时阻断新派发；不会把离线标记为成功。此功能不是关闭客户端仍运行的云端计划。
本地会话和执行归属可恢复；切换账户、撤销、退出及更新正确处理本机运行，取消只终止本任务拥有的进程/页面

decisions.interpretation: Local-session recovery and correct ownership/cleanup are mandatory. A closed-client background daemon, automatic wake or continued local monitoring after application exit is not established by these clauses. The initial report did not assert such a defect; this is a boundary for the consolidated assessment.
